in_marathi.name: Yogendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Discipline of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yogendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yogendar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Yoga' and 'Dharma'. It means 'One who leads with the discipline of Dharma'. Dharma is the law of the universe, the natural order of things, and Yoga is the practice of self-discipline and union with the divine.
